title: Credit Controller
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
Hays Accountancy & Finance are pleased to be partnering with a leading and highly respected organisation near Bury St Edmunds in the recruitment of an experienced Credit Controller. Following continued growth, the business is seeking a commercially minded professional to take ownership of the credit control function and play a pivotal role in safeguarding cash flow and mitigating financial risk.

Your new role
This is an excellent opportunity for an accomplished Credit Controller who enjoys working autonomously, managing complex customer accounts and influencing positive commercial outcomes. The successful candidate will become the primary point of contact for all credit control activities, supporting the wider business through the effective management of a substantial customer ledger.

Reporting to senior finance leadership, you will assume responsibility for the end-to-end management of a high-value sales ledger, overseeing customer accounts with monthly values ranging between £13 million and £18 million.
Key responsibilities will include:
- Managing and recovering outstanding debt to ensure timely collection of monies owed.
- Coordinating debt collection procedures for overdue accounts, including escalation to third-party collection specialists where appropriate.
- Liaising with solicitors, legal representatives and enforcement agencies to support legal recovery proceedings.
- Monitoring assigned accounts, reviewing aged debt and implementing effective recovery strategies to minimise financial exposure.
- Investigating and resolving customer disputes relating to invoice queries, outstanding balances and payment discrepancies.
- Reconciling customer accounts and ensuring accurate maintenance of account records.
- Processing account adjustments, refunds and short-payment reconciliations whilst maintaining a high standard of customer service.
- Assessing new customer accounts and obtaining authorisation for credit facilities, including reviewing and adjusting credit limits where necessary.
- Collaborating closely with Sales teams and senior management to accelerate collections and resolve customer issues efficiently.
- Building and maintaining effective working relationships with customers and internal stakeholders, including those with complex commercial requirements.

What you'll need to succeed
You will be a professional and resilient Credit Controller with a proven track record of delivering results within a fast-paced commercial environment. You will demonstrate:
- Significant experience in credit control, debt recovery and collections
- Experience managing a large and complex customer ledger.
- Knowledge of legal debt recovery procedures, debt collection agencies and credit insurers.
- Strong negotiation and influencing skills, with the confidence to manage challenging conversations and secure positive outcomes.
- Excellent analytical and reconciliation abilities with meticulous attention to detail.
- The ability to balance strong customer relationships with a firm commercial approach.
- A proactive, organised and self-motivated working style.
- Effective stakeholder management skills with the ability to work collaboratively across finance, sales and senior leadership teams.
- CICM qualifications would be advantageous; however, applications from candidates with substantial practical credit control experience are equally welcomed.

What you'll get in return
The organisation understands the importance of this role to the business and will tailor a benefits package for the successful candidate. Please contact Andy Jarman on for more details.

What you need to do now
If you are an experienced Credit Controller seeking an opportunity to take ownership of a key finance function within a successful and growing organisation, we would welcome your application. Please click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.

If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

As a result of their growth we have been engaged to recruit an additional part-time Bookkeeper & Payroll Administrator to join our close-knit team in Bury St Edmunds.

Free onsite parking

- Identifying and resolving discrepancies across customer accounts and ledgers.
- Preparing and presenting updates at credit control meetings.
- Supporting month-end procedures and ensuring financial information is accurate.
- Analysing and reporting on sales credit notes, ensuring they are valid and correctly processed.
- Supporting the wider Accounts team with holiday and absence cover when required.
- Assisting with the development of processes and reporting tools to improve credit control procedures.
- Carrying out other relevant accounts, administrative and credit control duties as required.

About You

We're looking for someone who is confident, organised and commercially aware, with previous experience in a credit control or sales ledger environment.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in credit control, accounts receivable or sales ledger.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Confidence making outbound credit control calls and dealing with payment queries.
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- The ability to analyse account information and identify discrepancies or potential risks.
- Good Excel and general IT skills.
- The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player.

Why Apply?

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Join Our Team as a Medical Receptionist at High Street Surgery At High Street Surgery, we believe every patient deserves to feel listened to, cared for, and supported from the moment they contact us. High Street Surgery is proud to be a CQC-rated Good practice and a designated training practice, supporting the development of doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals. Handling patient queries with empathy and confidentiality, signposting to healthcare professionals or external services when needed. Supporting clinicians by preparing notes, updating patient records, and ensuring the smooth flow of information within the practice.
